m.s: Mix {yoghurt*0.5} with {currypaste}, {garammasala}, {garlic*0.5} (crushed), the juice of {lemon*0.5} and 1 tsp salt. Coat {chk_thigh} and leave for at least 30 minutes, or overnight in the fridge for the best flavour.
Thinly slice {red_onion} and toss with {whitevinegar}, a pinch of sugar and a pinch of salt. Leave to turn pink while you cook.
Coarsely grate {cucumber} and squeeze out the water. Mix with the rest of the yoghurt, chopped {mint}, the rest of the garlic and a pinch of salt.

Rinse {rice} until the water runs clear. Put it in a saucepan with 1½ times its volume of cold water and a pinch of salt. Bring to the boil, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Take it off the heat and leave the lid on for 10 minutes so it finishes steaming.

Heat a grill pan, BBQ or heavy frying pan over high heat with a drizzle of oil. Cook the chicken for 5 to 6 minutes a side until charred at the edges and cooked through (75°C in the thickest part). Rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Warm {naan} in a dry pan. Serve the chicken with the rice, naan, raita, pickled onion and wedges of the remaining lemon.

l: Chicken over rice with the raita in a separate container. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF wraps or extra rice instead of naan. Check the curry paste label.
